description: Indian stock market (NSE/BSE) analytics webapp with Intraday, F&O, and Long-Term charts, AI price prediction charts, and Moneycontrol-sourced stock news.

userStories.title: Project Monorepo & Health Scaffold
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a clean Next.js (TypeScript/Tailwind) frontend and Python FastAPI backend scaffolded in the repository so both services run reliably together.
acceptanceCriteria: backend/ FastAPI app starts via uvicorn and exposes GET /api/health returning {"status": "ok"}
frontend/ Next.js App Router (TypeScript + Tailwind CSS) builds cleanly with npm run build
CORS configured between localhost:3000 and localhost:8000
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Verified with pytest and npm run build

userStories.title: NSE/BSE Stock Search & Live Quote API
userStories.description: As a user, I want to search any NSE/BSE stock or index and fetch its live price quote so I can switch stocks effortlessly.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/stocks/search?q=<query> returns matching NSE/BSE symbols, names, exchange, and is_fno flag
GET /api/stocks/{symbol}/quote returns LTP, delta, OHLC, volume, 52W range, market status, and cache timestamp
Backend uses TTL caching and gracefully falls back to cached data on upstream throttling
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Covered by pytest test_search_stocks and test_quote_endpoint

userStories.title: Terminal Shell, Stock Search Bar, Market Pulse & Watchlist UI
userStories.description: As a trader, I want a dark-mode terminal header with instant stock search, Market Pulse top ticker, 1-click Local Watchlist, and an auto-refreshing live quote bar.
acceptanceCriteria: Market Pulse top bar displays live NIFTY 50, SENSEX, BANKNIFTY, and INDIA VIX
Debounced search dropdown with keyboard navigation and 1-click Local Watchlist (localStorage) for favorite NSE stocks/indices
Live Quote Bar displays LTP in INR, green/red change, day range, volume, market status badge, and polls every 10s
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Next.js typecheck and build pass cleanly

userStories.title: Multi-Horizon OHLCV & Technical Indicators API
userStories.description: As a trader, I want historical and intraday OHLCV candle data with pre-computed indicators so Intraday and Long-Term charts render fast and accurately.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/stocks/{symbol}/history supports mode=intraday|longterm with intervals 1m,5m,15m,1h and ranges 3mo,6mo,1y,3y,5y,max
Returns OHLCV candles plus VWAP, EMA9, EMA21, SMA50, SMA200, and RSI14
Handles market holidays/weekends cleanly by returning latest session data with session date label
Tests pass

userStories.title: Intraday, Long-Term Charts & Technical Bias Strip UI
userStories.description: As a trader, I want separate Intraday and Long-Term chart tabs using TradingView Lightweight Charts plus a Technical & F&O Bias Strip.
acceptanceCriteria: Mode tabs switch cleanly between Intraday, F&O, and Long-Term
Quick Technical & F&O Bias Strip displays Bullish/Neutral/Bearish gauge above the chart
Intraday tab supports 1m/5m/15m/1h intervals and toggleable VWAP, EMA 9/21, Volume, and RSI(14)
Long-Term tab supports 3M/6M/1Y/3Y/5Y/MAX ranges and toggleable 50 DMA, 200 DMA, and 52W High/Low lines
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: NSE F&O Option Chain & Derivatives Analytics API
userStories.description: As an F&O trader, I want live/cached NSE option chain data with PCR, Max Pain, and ATM IV for F&O-eligible stocks and indices.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/stocks/{symbol}/fno fetches NSE public option chain with session priming and 45s TTL cache
Computes PCR, Max Pain strike, Call OI resistance, Put OI support, and ATM IV across expiries
Non-F&O stocks return structured fno_eligible=false response cleanly
Tests pass

userStories.title: F&O Chart & Option Chain Analytics UI
userStories.description: As an F&O trader, I want an F&O tab displaying the underlying price chart alongside strike-wise Call/Put OI bars, PCR, Max Pain, and expiry selector.
acceptanceCriteria: F&O tab renders Spot, PCR, Max Pain, Call Resistance, Put Support, and ATM IV metric cards
Renders strike-wise Call OI vs Put OI bar chart around ATM and an Option Chain table with expiry selector
Non-F&O stocks display a clear explanatory notice
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: AI Price Prediction Engine & Backtest API
userStories.description: As a trader, I want a backend forecasting API that generates horizon-specific AI price predictions and walk-forward backtest accuracy scores for any stock.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/stocks/{symbol}/predict?mode=intraday|fno|longterm returns predicted series with upper/lower 1sigma and 2sigma bands
Computes walk-forward directional accuracy %, MAPE %, and RMSE on held-out historical candles
Confidence bands satisfy lower_2sigma <= lower_1sigma <= predicted <= upper_1sigma <= upper_2sigma
Tests pass

userStories.title: AI Prediction Chart Overlay & Metrics UI
userStories.description: As a trader, I want to see the AI Prediction Chart overlaid onto (or compared alongside) my Intraday, F&O, and Long-Term charts so I can visualize expected direction and risk bands.
acceptanceCriteria: Toggleable AI Prediction overlay renders dashed forecast line and shaded 1sigma/2sigma confidence bands on the chart
Summary bar displays target price, expected % move, Directional Accuracy %, MAPE, and non-advisory disclaimer
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Moneycontrol & Multi-Source Stock News Aggregator API
userStories.description: As an investor/trader, I want a backend news API that fetches both current and historical news for the selected stock from Moneycontrol, Economic Times, LiveMint, and Google News RSS.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/stocks/{symbol}/news aggregates and deduplicates articles from Moneycontrol, ET, LiveMint, and Google News RSS
Supports timeframe (today, 7d, 30d, all) and source filters with 5m TTL cache
Assigns Bullish, Bearish, or Neutral financial sentiment score to each headline
Tests pass

userStories.title: Stock News Feed Panel & Chart News Event Pins UI
userStories.description: As a trader, I want a clean News Section showing current and historical news plus News Event Pins plotted on Long-Term candlesticks.
acceptanceCriteria: News panel displays headline, source badge, timestamp, sentiment pill, and external article link
Timeframe (Today, 7D, 30D, Historical) and Source (All, Moneycontrol, ET, LiveMint) filters work
Long-Term chart overlays clickable News Event Pins on historical candles matching article dates
Switching stock reloads news cleanly with loading state
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Verified with npm run build and markers integration
